title: Trim Video - Cut Video
summary: Trim and cut videos fast. Keep only the parts that matter - no watermark
description:
Trim Video - Cut Video: cut your clips to exactly the parts that matter, in seconds.

Trim the start and end off any video, or cut out the boring middle and keep only the highlights. Precise controls, no watermark - and simple trims keep your video's original quality.

✂️ PRECISE TRIMMING & CUTTING
Drag the handles to select your clip, nudge the boundaries in half-second steps, or type an exact timestamp down to the millisecond.

🎬 KEEP MULTIPLE SEGMENTS
Select more than one segment of the same video - cut out the middle, keep the intro and the finale - then merge the segments into one video or export them separately.

🔍 CROP & SPEED
Crop with aspect-ratio presets (square, portrait and more) and change playback speed from 0.5x slow motion to 8x fast forward - all in the same export.

🔊 VOLUME & MUTE
Lower the volume or mute your clip entirely before saving.

💎 ORIGINAL QUALITY, NO WATERMARK
Simple trims are saved without re-encoding whenever possible, keeping the original quality, resolution and format. And there's never a watermark or logo on your output.

🗂️ BATCH PROCESSING
Trim multiple videos in one go.

📤 SAVE & SHARE ANYWHERE
Save as a new file or replace the original, then share straight to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, WhatsApp and more. Everything is processed on your device - nothing is uploaded.

PERFECT FOR:
📱 Cutting clips for reels, stories & shorts
🎥 Trimming long recordings down to the highlight
📧 Making videos short enough to send
🏠 Cleaning up home videos before sharing

Simple, fast, and free. Download Trim Video and cut your first clip in seconds.
